---
title: "SAF Business Layer"
subtitle: "How a statistical organization turns externally-held data into trusted statistics, described as ten value streams"
---

This site documents the business layer of the **Statistical Architecture Framework (SAF)**: the business processes, roles, services, objects, and events through which a National Statistical Office (NSO) produces official statistics. The documents are a **canvas** — NSOs are expected to instantiate them for their own context, not to adopt them verbatim.

New to architecture documents? Every page opens with a collapsible **"Key concepts"** box that explains the few architecture terms used (value stream, steady state, the four process types, GSBPM, GAMSO) in plain language — start with the [consolidated overview](SAF-Business-Layer.qmd).

## Reading order

1. Start with the **[consolidated overview](SAF-Business-Layer.qmd)** — it explains once the shared scaffolding (the data value chain and its steady states, the four-process governance pattern, the principles), then summarises all ten streams.
2. Then dive into the per-stream documents below as needed.

## Primary value streams — the production chain

Six streams form a linear chain; each consumes one steady state of data and produces the next.

| Stream | Steady-state transition | Purpose |
|--------|------------------------|---------|
| [VS-01 Data Acquisition and Ingestion](VS-01.0-Data-Acquisition-and-Ingestion.qmd) | Source → Raw | Bring external data into NSO custody through a governed pipeline |
| [VS-02 Data Standardization and Integration](VS-02.0-Data-Standardization-and-Integration.qmd) | Raw → Standardized | Align heterogeneous sources to common structures and classifications, without loss of content |
| [VS-03 Data Editing and Enrichment](VS-03.0-Data-Editing-and-Enrichment.qmd) | Standardized → Processed | Correct errors, impute missing values, derive variables — under full lineage |
| [VS-04 Estimation, Analysis, and Statistical Modeling](VS-04.0-Estimation-Analysis-and-Statistical-Modeling.qmd) | Processed → Output | Turn microdata into representative statistics with accuracy measures |
| [VS-05 Statistical Product Composition](VS-05.0-Statistical-Product-Composition.qmd) | Output → Output (products) | Compose validated outputs into coherent, approved statistical products |
| [VS-06 Dissemination and Service Delivery](VS-06.0-Dissemination-and-Service-Delivery.qmd) | Output → Published | Release products through trusted, secure, equal-access channels |

Each primary document follows the same template: strategic context → roles and actors → the four governance process groups (*Design, Implementation, Execution, Management*) → services, objects, and events → applying this to your NSO.

## Supporting value streams

Four streams run horizontally and continuously across the chain; they align to GAMSO rather than GSBPM and are documented in a leaner continuous-capability format.

| Stream | Value created |
|--------|---------------|
| [VS-07 Governance and Compliance](VS-07.0-Governance-and-Compliance.qmd) | Integrity and accountability |
| [VS-08 Innovation and Methodological Development](VS-08.0-Innovation-and-Methodological-Development.qmd) | Continuous improvement |
| [VS-09 Infrastructure and Platform Enablement](VS-09.0-Infrastructure-and-Platform-Enablement.qmd) | Reliable enablement of the statistical mission |
| [VS-10 Customer and Stakeholder Engagement](VS-10.0-Customer-and-Stakeholder-Engagement.qmd) | Relevance and public value |
